# Seekable zstd: frame size, archive size and first-read latency

[Protocol and prediction](CALIBRATION.md) · [Machine and build](enwik8-L3/run.json) · [Reproduce](reproduce.sh)

Archive size change is relative to the 64 MiB frame on the same corpus and level, including the seek table.
The archive is in RAM. First and repeat time the same request on the same reader; each pair starts with a newly initialized reader.
Each latency is the median of five per-run nearest-rank percentiles. Memory is the median process peak RSS across those runs, including the resident archive.

Raw samples, archive hashes and corruption controls: [enwik8 L3](enwik8-L3/), [enwik8 L19](enwik8-L19/), [silesia L3](silesia-L3/), [silesia L19](silesia-L19/).
